blocks.body:
## Current verdict

Nimbo is **not ready to scale acquisition**. The canonical August 30 capture at 00:00:25 +05:00 still fails every required goal surface, so the verified streak remains 0/7: Apple weather search is #87, the official Apple Weather chart is #22, all three fixed logged-out Google category profiles are outside the first 30, and 0/5 generic Google queries qualify. The auxiliary Apple Toshkent ob-havo search returned only one unique result and is a non-goal diagnostic error; goal evidence remains complete. The historical iOS 1.0.1 crash still has no diagnostic or symbolicated stack. Current product/build-input commit 44c189209c793cf097fcc293faf8db88033e6902 keeps phone 1.1.0 (8), Wear OS 1.1.0 (1000008), and Apple 1.1.0 (6), and adds fail-closed Apple source-revision plumbing. No retained AAB, archive, or IPA was built or signed from it, so 0/3 current artifacts are byte-verified. Predecessor commit 9c2dce4200dbba5487c8c458ade4616005fde6e6 closes three deterministic storage-failure exception escapes and adds four throwing-repository regressions, but all of its binaries, screenshots, and device results are historical and non-transferable. OpenMeteo GmbH confirmed non-commercial API entitlement in ticket 234272 for the exact free, non-monetized, unpaid-organic-promotion scope. Predecessor phone and Wear AABs embed 9c2dce4, pass Bundletool and ZIP integrity, and have zero signature entries. Their SHA-256 values are b7c7acb6e90189e8d73e5b8a5f780bf1d3ab36f43edaf3d5076a1dba4e22d4e5 and 2d73fdf1e4fd661a96a699a9fd2ef7b2e989b0f4ab019692ce7c97465673d3fa. Predecessor Apple app, widget, and watch Release simulator hashes are b7c3ba937658007b07ee9ad8e85ddc892e90f423e7839e0dc112a1070ea04849, 7191acd40334d4d9fec6062bc5023450fefbb55006fbd92f57109f41eb27a7ff, and c310c785750ffa779e5dfdc30384088fca889deddb11417f2b4e8e0e30109728; UUID-matched dSYMs verify, but all are ad-hoc simulator products. The full Gradle release gate, shared iOS simulator suite, 18 Apple surface tests, and localization parity pass. A clean predecessor physical General Mobile API 25 run passed Tashkent without location permission, live forecast, truthful late-day Best Time, durable-tip persistence, offline cache, recovery, process health, and cleanup; built and installed APK bytes matched at 52146b883a04e4c2d272ea4e3ecc9b1277a8c78c117b547a121de3a7d90c3730 and the product-scoped fatal/ANR/SSL/CertPath/trust-anchor filter had zero matches. The exact-source API 24 emulator APK 168bb6acdb95453a8dfd141947edbcb9292b756fd3429fffa56fc4baf125dbec retains its live/cache/recovery pass. The byte-identical predecessor debug APK and API 36 installed bytes 52146b883a04e4c2d272ea4e3ecc9b1277a8c78c117b547a121de3a7d90c3730 also passed a fresh no-snapshot Pixel Tablet emulator smoke in Uzbek: landscape onboarding, live forecast, Best Time, durable-tip persistence, home-screen widget render/tap, large text, rotation, process health, and cleanup passed. This is emulator debug evidence, not physical-tablet or upload-signed release proof. Twelve EN/RU/UZ iPhone phone sources now come from the source-bound predecessor 9c2dce4 build-6 simulator app and cover overview, recent comparison, selected timeline, and 10-day/AQI details in each locale. The attempted Apple offline transition was not captured and no Apple offline-state source is claimed. This proves localized phone screenshot provenance only, not signing, physical-device, TestFlight, or store state. Apple Watch sources remain historical build-5 simulator evidence, and prior API 37 round-Wear evidence remains historical. There is no exact-current signed phone/Wear artifact, distribution-signed Apple archive, iOS 15 runtime pass, or matching physical matrix. Android Keychain metadata and the existing mode-600 keystore are present, but protected signing access remains unavailable. At 20:44 +05:00 the iPad was paired but not action-ready; the iPhone and watch remained unavailable. Google Play Custom Store Listing 4834799756935529888 remains an Uzbekistan-only draft. Authenticated App Store Connect inventory reads expose public iOS 1.0.1 with valid build 4 and no 1.1.0 version or builds 5/6. Build-detail and diagnostic-signature GETs for build 4 returned security 403. One bounded POST attempting to create only a manual-release 1.1.0 version also returned 403; the final authenticated GET again returned zero 1.1.0 versions, proving that no partial version or localization draft was created. No build, localization, screenshot, Custom Product Page, submission, or release mutation followed. Apple subtitles and creatives remain repository-prepared payloads, not an App Store Connect draft or public store state. The same authenticated preflight found zero existing analytics report requests. Exactly one bounded ONGOING analytics-report-request POST for app 6799886897 returned security 403 without a resource ID; it was not retried, and no duplicate, report instance, segment, user-level data, or PII was created or downloaded. Automated weekly Apple analytics remains permission-blocked for the current key. The domain and point-in-time store-policy gates remain pass, every critical console guardrail remains unknown, and the Play conversion denominator is still unreconciled. Scale status remains hold; public outreach and acquisition scaling remain gated on crash diagnosis, source-synced signed phone, Wear OS, and Apple artifacts, complete physical-device coverage, and critical console guardrails.

## Authenticated Play context

At 23:37–23:46 +05:00 on August 29, the global default rating remained 1.000 from one user and the all-time review inbox contained zero written reviews. The lone star-only rating has no reply surface and is not attributed to Uzbekistan, a device, version, or storefront. Account-level email notifications were enabled and saved for new one- through five-star reviews and edited reviews; the dashboard contains no email address, reviewer data, or other PII. The daily heartbeat checks the Nimbo review inbox once per day after 09:15 Asia/Tashkent.

The rolling Last 28 days acquisition snapshot showed 778 device impressions, 21 installs, 14 first opens, 11 monthly active devices, unavailable D7 retention, and 40.82% summary conversion. The historical baseline remains 779 impressions. The separate July 27–August 23 Store Listings window showed 44 visitors, 18 install clicks, and 41% CTR across listing surfaces; its default-listing row separately showed 42 visitors and 28.6% conversion. These populations are not merged. In the exact August 16–22 report, UZ remained requested but its series was omitted from both Console and CSV, so no UZ visitor, acquisition, or conversion value is imported, zero-filled, or derived. Evidence: growth/quality/google-play-console-2026-08-29.md, growth/quality/weekly-console-evidence-2026-08-29.md, and growth/reviews/README.md.

## Operating rule

Unknown quality, provider, release identity, domain, or physical-device evidence is never converted into a pass. External UI side effects remain action-time gated by the execution surface, and the zero-budget boundary remains in force.

-- Reproducible bounded snapshot of the reported store-console baseline.
-- Values preserve each console metric as reported; they are not recomputed
-- across incompatible denominators.
SELECT *
FROM (
  VALUES
    ('App Store', 'Impressions', '206', 'reported_console_readout'),
    ('App Store', 'First-time downloads', '5', 'reported_console_readout'),
    ('App Store', 'Conversion rate', '4.05%', 'reported_console_readout'),
    ('App Store', 'Ratings', '0', 'reported_console_readout'),
    ('App Store', 'Crashes', '1', 'live_console_2026-08-29'),
    ('Google Play', 'Impressions', '779', 'reported_console_readout'),
    ('Google Play', 'Installations', '21', 'live_console_2026-08-28'),
    ('Google Play', 'First launches', '14', 'live_console_2026-08-28'),
    ('Google Play', 'Monthly active users', '11', 'live_console_2026-08-28'),

    ('Google Play UZ generic-query quorum', '2-of-3 profiles', 'five configured queries', '0 qualifying queries', 2, 'fixed_logged_out_capture')

query.description: Loads the complete required goal surfaces from the canonical public-rank capture while preserving bounded absences; one auxiliary non-goal Apple query is incomplete.
tables_used: inline rank values backed by growth/data/public-rank/2026-08-30.json

goal_evidence_complete=true and evaluation.complete=true for all required goal surfaces

Google generic success requires Top-10 on at least two of three profiles for at least two queries

query.description: Loads the evaluated Top-10 streak state for the latest UZ rank day.
